en.title: Normalize a digit slip
en.statement: Read one input line containing only decimal digits from 0 through 9. It represents a value between zero and 9999, and leading zeros are allowed. Convert that text to a number and print the numeric value on one line, without adding one. Print no input prompt. For example, input 007 produces 7. The supplied input-reading setup is ready; write the conversion and output inside the indicated program area.
hints: Keep the input-reading setup and inspect which name holds its text.
Use your track's learned conversion to store a numeric result under count.
Print count itself, without quotes or an addition. A numeric value removes unnecessary leading zeros.

digits = input()
